issues.description: The class StockIngredient in the template defines a getter named retrieveQuantity() (method at src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java lines 36-38), while other template code and the solution expect a conventional getQuantity() method. Template Stock.java calls stockIngredient.getQuantity() (e.g., src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java lines 36-37) and Main.java also calls getQuantity() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java line 15). The problem statement instructs students to "add getters for all the private fields", which implies the conventional getX naming. This naming mismatch will cause compilation errors for the provided template and will confuse students about the expected getter name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API consistent by adding a getQuantity() method to StockIngredient that returns the quantity (either rename retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity() or add a getQuantity() wrapper that delegates to retrieveQuantity()). Ensure all template callers (Stock, Main, and tests) compile against the same getter name and align the template with the problem statement's "add getters" instruction.
